risk_summary: The excerpt provides useful quantitative disclosure, including a 20% revenue decline, 65% cost of revenue, and extreme reliance on one customer representing 67% of 2023 revenue. Key risks include potential customer exit, uncertain account volumes and license-tier economics, dependence on adding customers to achieve scale, offshore execution capacity, and possible future investment impairments. The tone is cautiously negative because current performance weakened and several material outcomes remain outside management’s control.
